title: Knee Brace and Biomechanical Footwear in the Treatment of Knee Osteoarthritis.
brief_summary: This study investigates the effects of unloader knee brace, biomechanical footwear device and exercise therapy on pain, physical function and quality of life in patients with knee osteoarthritis. The aim is to find more effective treatment strategies to delay or prevent heavy knee replacement surgeries.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* moderate or severe knee pain (\>40mm on a VAS scale 0-100mm)
* radiographic knee osteoarthritis (Kellgren-Lawrence grades 1-3)
* age between 45 and 70 years

Exclusion Criteria:

* inflammatory joint disease
* acute (\<6 months) knee trauma
* arthroscopic surgery in the past six months
* a planned knee replacement surgery or other planned surgical treatment of the knee
* knee injections in the past 3 months
* superficial wounds at the knee area
* arterial insufficiency
* severe varicosities
* impaired vision
* postural difficulties
* body-mass index (BMI) \>35kg/m2
* fibromyalgia
* rheumatoid arthritis or other active rheumatoid inflammatory disease.
